question: Bathukamma, a flower festival, is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Telangana.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bathukamma** is a **flower festival **celebrated during the month of **September/October**, which marks the beginning of the **autumn season. **
 
• It is celebrated in **Telangana.**
 
• The festival is celebrated by** women,** who make a **beautiful arrangement of flowers **in the form of a **cone-shaped structure **and immerse it in water on the last day of the festival. 
 
• The festival is a** symbol of unity and sisterhood** among women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tamil Nadu** is known for its **Pongal festival, **which is celebrated in **January **to mark the **harvest season.**
 
• **Gujarat** is known for its **Navratri festival**, which is celebrated in honor of the goddess** Durga.**
 
• **Rajasthan** is known for its **colorful festival of Holi,** which is celebrated to mark the **arrival of spring.**
